extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figures 1a, 1b, 1d, 5a, and 5b. Figure 1c was skipped because it reports mass-spectrometer signal intensities rather than NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. Figures 2–4 were skipped as characterization/structural figures. Figure 5b was treated as a time-on-stream plot, so only the first and last plotted point for each series were extracted.
